#Load libraries
```{r}
library(stats)
library(factoextra)
library(tcplfit2)
library(ggrepel)
library(cowplot)

dir.create(
  file.path(pipeline_output_path, "tcplfit_results_cat"),
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)
```

#Category level Principal component analysis, Mahalanobis distance calculations, and Concentration-response analysis
```{r}
# Discover all Well-level simplified CSV files produced by sheet 2
simplified_files <- list.files(
  file.path(pipeline_output_path, "feature_results"),
  pattern = "^Well-level_data_simplified_categories.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

message("Found ", length(simplified_files), " feature-set files to process (category-level).")

walk(simplified_files, function(path) {

  # --- Label for output file names ---
  file_label <- basename(path) |>
    stringr::str_remove("^Well-level_data_simplified_categories") |>
    stringr::str_remove("\\.csv$")

  if (file_label == "") file_label <- "_all_features"

  message("\n=== Processing (category-level): ", basename(path), " ===")

  # --- Load data ---
  test_chem_well <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(test_chem_well) <- test_chem_well[[1]]
  test_chem_well <- test_chem_well[, -1]

  # well_data mirrors test_chem_well (samples x features) — needed later
  # for the raw (non-PCA-space) Mahalanobis calc, same as in the original script
  well_data <- test_chem_well

  # --- Transpose & attach category labels ---
  test_chem_well_cat <- t(test_chem_well) |> as.data.frame()

  # Capture feature names as ft_colnames2 before clearing row names,
  # so they can be cbound back in as the "features" column
  ft_colnames2 <- rownames(test_chem_well_cat)

  test_chem_well_cat <- cbind(ft_colnames2, test_chem_well_cat)
  rownames(test_chem_well_cat) <- NULL
  # --- Filter out categories with fewer than 2 features ---
  cat_lev_data <- test_chem_well_cat |>
    dplyr::group_by(features) |>
    dplyr::mutate(count = n()) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::filter(count > 1)

  cat_lev_data <- cat_lev_data[, -ncol(cat_lev_data)]

  samples <- colnames(cat_lev_data)[2:ncol(cat_lev_data)]
  ft_cats <- unique(cat_lev_data$features)

  # --- PCA by category ---
  pca_cat <- lapply(ft_cats, function(x) {
    cat_dat <- cat_lev_data[, grep(x, colnames(cat_lev_data))]
    prcomp(cat_dat, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
  }) |> setNames(ft_cats)

  # --- Category Mahalanobis distances ---
  cat_mahal_dist <- lapply(ft_cats, function(x) {

    pca <- pca_cat[[x]]

    cumulative_prop <- cumsum(pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)
    PC_95 <- length(which(cumulative_prop < 0.95)) + 1

    pca_x <- as.data.frame(pca$x)
    pca_x <- as.data.frame(cbind(chem = samples, pca_x))

    ctrl_pc <- pca_x |> dplyr::filter(grepl(ctrl_group, chem))
    ctrl_pc <- ctrl_pc[, -1]
    ctrl_mean <- colMeans(ctrl_pc)

    cat_dat <- well_data[, grep(x, colnames(well_data))]
    zero_col <- sapply(cat_dat, function(col) all(col == 0))
    cat_dat <- cat_dat[, !zero_col]

    dat <- as.matrix(cat_dat) %*% pca$rotation[, 1:PC_95]
    Cov <- cov(dat)

    mahal_dist <- mahalanobis(dat, ctrl_mean, Cov, inverted = FALSE)
    mahal_dist <- as.data.frame(mahal_dist)
    mahal_dist <- sqrt(mahal_dist)

    mahal_dist <- cbind(chem = rownames(well_data), mahal_dist)

    sample_info <- tibble::tibble(sample_info = mahal_dist$chem) |>
      tidyr::separate(sample_info, c("chem", "concentration", "well", "well2"),
                       sep = "_", remove = TRUE)
    sample_info$well <- paste0(sample_info$well, "_", sample_info$well2)

    cbind(sample_info[1:3], mahal_dist = mahal_dist$mahal_dist)
  }) |> setNames(ft_cats)

  chem_list <- unique(cat_mahal_dist[[1]][["chem"]])

  # --- Separate categorical Mahalanobis distances by chemical ---
  mahal_dist_chem <- lapply(chem_list, function(x) {
    chem_dat <- lapply(ft_cats, function(y) {
      dplyr::filter(cat_mahal_dist[[y]], chem == x)
    }) |> setNames(ft_cats)
    do.call(rbind, chem_dat)
  }) |> setNames(chem_list) |> do.call(rbind, args = _)

  mahal_dist_chem$feat <- rownames(mahal_dist_chem)
  mahal_dist_chem$feat <- stringr::str_extract(mahal_dist_chem$feat, "(?<=\\.).*?(?=\\.)")
  rownames(mahal_dist_chem) <- NULL

  # --- Per-chemical Mahalanobis plots (kept off by default, same as script 1's per-plate plots) ---
  lapply(chem_list, function(x) {
    p <- ggplot(
      mahal_dist_chem[mahal_dist_chem$chem == x, ],
      aes(x = as.numeric(concentration), y = mahal_dist, colour = feat)
    ) +
      geom_point() +
      scale_y_continuous() +
      scale_x_log10() +
      scale_color_manual(values = turbo(333)) +
      xlab("Concentration (\u03BCM)") + ylab("Mahalanobis Distance") +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, margin = margin(t = 15)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, margin = margin(r = 15), angle = 90),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, colour = "black"),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1)
      ) +
      facet_wrap(vars(feat), scales = "free") +
      ggtitle(paste0(x, file_label))

    # ggsave(
    #   filename = file.path(plots, paste0(x, file_label, "_Categorical_mahalanobis.png")),
    #   plot = p, width = 45, height = 45, units = "cm"
    # )
  })

  # --- tcplfit2 concentration-response modeling per category ---
  mahal_dist_chem <- as.data.frame(mahal_dist_chem)

  test_chem_res <- mahal_dist_chem |> dplyr::filter(chem != ctrl_group)

  conc_res_modeling <- function(test_chem, vehicle_ctrl) {
    row <- list(
      conc   = as.numeric(test_chem$concentration),
      resp   = test_chem$mahal_dist,
      bmed   = vehicle_ctrl$Median,
      cutoff = vehicle_ctrl$nMad,
      onesd  = vehicle_ctrl$nMad,
      name   = paste0(test_chem$chem[1], "_", test_chem$feat[1]),
      assay  = "Mahalanobis distance (cutoff = 1)"
    )
    tcplfit2::concRespCore(
      row, conthits = TRUE, aicc = TRUE, force.fit = FALSE, bidirectional = TRUE,
      fitmodels = c("cnst", "hill", "poly1", "poly2", "pow", "exp2", "exp3", "exp4", "exp5")
    )
  }

  chem_list_i <- unique(test_chem_res$chem)
  feats <- unique(test_chem_res$feat)

  vehicle_ctrl <- mahal_dist_chem |>
    dplyr::filter(chem == ctrl_group) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      Median = median(mahal_dist, na.rm = TRUE),
      nMad   = mad(mahal_dist, constant = 1.4826, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  tcpl_results_cat_i <- lapply(chem_list_i, function(x) {
    chem_data <- test_chem_res[test_chem_res$chem == x, ]

    lapply(feats, function(y) {
      chem_data_y <- chem_data |> dplyr::filter(grepl(y, feat))
      conc_res_modeling(chem_data_y, vehicle_ctrl)

      # Individual feature concentration-response curves — off by default
      # concRespPlot(tcpl_chem, ymin = min(chem_data_y$mahal_dist) - 5,
      #              ymax = max(chem_data_y$mahal_dist) + 10, draw.error.arrows = FALSE)
    }) |> do.call(rbind, args = _)
  }) |> do.call(rbind, args = _)

  split_col <- stringr::str_split_fixed(tcpl_results_cat_i$name, "_", 2)
  tcpl_results_cat_i <- cbind("chem" = split_col[, 1], "feat" = split_col[, 2], tcpl_results_cat_i[, -1])

  tcpl_results_cat_i <- tcpl_results_cat_i |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      minDose = min(conc, na.rm = TRUE),
      maxDose = max(conc, na.rm = TRUE),
      removal_reason = dplyr::case_when(
        hitcall < 0.9   ~ "low_hitcall",
        is.na(bmdl)     ~ "missing_bmdl",
        is.na(bmdu)     ~ "missing_bmdu",
        TRUE            ~ "kept"
      ),
      keep = removal_reason == "kept",
      bmd  = ifelse(keep, bmd,  NA),
      bmdl = ifelse(keep, bmdl, NA),
      bmdu = ifelse(keep, bmdu, NA)
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::filter(er < 0.99)

  tcpl_results_cat_i$exp_name <- exp_name

  # --- BMC plot ---
  BMC_plot <- ggplot(tcpl_results_cat_i, aes(x = bmd, y = feat, colour = feat)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = bmdl, xmax = bmdu), width = 0.2) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    xlab("Best BMC (1MAD above vehicle control median) \u03BCM") +
    ylab("Feature Category") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17, margin = margin(t = 20)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black", margin = margin(r = 5)),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
    ) +
    facet_wrap(vars(chem)) +
    ggtitle(paste0("Categorical BMC — ", file_label))

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plots, paste0("Categorical_BMC", file_label, ".png")),
    plot = BMC_plot, width = 25, height = 35, units = "cm"
  )

  # --- Save tcpl results table ---
  write_csv(
    tcpl_results_cat_i,
    file.path(
      pipeline_output_path, "tcplfit_results_cat",
      paste0("tcpl_results_cat", file_label, ".csv")
    )
  )

  message("Done (category-level): ", basename(path))
})
```
